schedules.description: A normal retry cancels its predecessor before one original-file enqueue and one notice.
Two ordinary retries preserve attempt order, exactly-once records, and owned cleanup.
The native abort observer runs synchronously without navigation; the retry notice remains live.
Native abort hides synchronously; accepted retry remains recorded with no retired-visit notice.
Native abort selects B; accepted A retry remains recorded while B retains ownership and later retry.
Native abort hides and reopens the identical A object; old visit stays retired and new A remains live.
A hidden panel accepts no retry command.
Selection cancellation can receive newer selection without overwriting it; hide cancels the final owner.
The physical carrier sends one native abort event despite repeated cancellation.
Disposing one workspace does not cancel or suppress another workspace's retry.
Queue record shape is unchanged unless the byteCount extension is separately granted.
